title: District of Arizona Charges 374 Individuals for Immigration-Related Criminal Conduct this Week
summary: PHOENIX, Ariz. – During the week of enforcement operations from Sep. 26 through Oct. 2, 2026, the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Arizona brought immigration-related criminal charges against 374 individuals.
